hero.filename: Frank Sinatra and Harry James at the Hollywood Canteen, 1943.jpg
hero.title: File:Frank Sinatra and Harry James at the Hollywood Canteen, 1943.jpg
hero.artist: Photographer uncredited and unknown. Distributed by the photo department of CBS.
hero.credit:
*Original source: The image was originally distributed as a publicity photo by Columbia Broadcasting System (i.e., CBS. An extremely similar (but not identical) photo was published at page 4 of the November 1943 issue (Vol. 1, No. 8) of Tune In magazine, published by the D. S. Publishing Company at 30 Rockefeller Plaza in New York.
Scans of the original publicity photo (front and back) can be seen at this WorthPoint listing. Cropped from the original image and retouched by uploader; see upload history for unretouched original.
hero.source: Frank Sinatra and Harry James at the Hollywood Canteen, 1943
hero.description: Publicity photo of Frank Sinatra (center) performing at the Hollywood Canteen for US servicemen during World War II, accompanied by Harry James (left, standing with sheet music) and his big band.
categories: Black and white portrait photographs of musicians
